_comment: Slugs are the company identifier in each ATS board URL. greenhouse: boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>. lever: jobs.lever.co/<slug>. ashby: jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>. Every slug here was verified to return that company's postings on 2026-09-03. climatebase entries are search queries, not slugs; each returns its top 100. title_filter: a title must match at least one regex (case-insensitive). title_exclude: a title matching any regex is dropped before the model sees it. hackernews, remoteok, himalayas, and apple are whole feeds; their values are ignored. apple is a whole feed too: every US posting Apple marks home-office eligible. Boards that 404 are skipped. Keyword filters (title_filter, title_exclude) live in each person's people/<name>/sources.json.
_not_coverable: Own careers sites or ATSs without a public feed, checked 2026-09-03: Meta, Fly.io, Oxide, HashiCorp, Astral, Modular, Hugging Face, dbt Labs, Dagster, Snyk, Felt, CARTO, Hipcamp, REI, Patagonia, Tesla, Rivian, Trek, Specialized. Check by hand or add a fetcher.
